name: How long does it take to build a detached garage?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to build a detached garage?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for building a detached garage varies based on its size, complexity, weather conditions, and the efficiency of permit approvals. Generally, from breaking ground to final inspection, a standard two-car detached garage can take anywhere from 6 to 12 weeks. Custom designs, extensive site work, or unexpected delays can extend this period. We provide a detailed project schedule at the outset, keeping you informed of progress every step of the way.
acceptedAnswer.description: A standard detached garage usually takes 6 to 12 weeks to build, depending on size, complexity, and permit processing. Custom projects may take longer.
